title: A Weekend at the Pool
setting: A large sports centre with a swimming pool and a small shop by the exit.

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: Omar, a young boy with short black hair and blue swim shorts

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow swimsuit

characters.name: Mother
characters.look: their mother, a woman with glasses and a green coat

sentences.en: Swimming is Omar and Nina's favourite weekend activity.
sentences.zh: 游泳是奥马尔和妮娜最喜欢的周末活动。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young boy with short black hair and blue swim shorts and Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow swimsuit jump happily into a big indoor swimming pool.

sentences.en: The pool is free for children this year.
sentences.zh: 今年这个泳池对孩子免费。
sentences.scene_prompt: Many happy children swim in a large indoor pool while their mother, a woman with glasses and a green coat watches from a bench.

sentences.en: They play in the water for an hour.
sentences.zh: 他们在水里玩了一个小时。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young boy with short black hair and blue swim shorts and Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow swimsuit splash each other and play with a ball in the pool.

sentences.en: Nina wants to be a swimmer in the future.
sentences.zh: 妮娜将来想当一名游泳运动员。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow swimsuit swims fast in the pool and dreams of standing on a winner's podium.

sentences.en: Before they go home, they visit the shop.
sentences.zh: 回家之前，他们去了商店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young boy with short black hair and blue swim shorts, Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow swimsuit and their mother, a woman with glasses and a green coat, now dressed, walk into a small shop at the sports centre.

sentences.en: The shop has sweaters in many different colours.
sentences.zh: 这家店有很多不同颜色的毛衣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Shelves in the small shop are full of sweaters in red, blue, green and yellow.

sentences.en: Omar buys a large white one for Mother.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔给妈妈买了一件大号白毛衣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar, a young boy with short black hair and blue swim shorts proudly holds up a large white sweater for their mother, a woman with glasses and a green coat.

sentences.en: Their mother keeps it on all the way home.
sentences.zh: 妈妈一路上都穿着它回家。
sentences.scene_prompt: their mother, a woman with glasses and a green coat wears the white sweater and walks home smiling with Omar, a young boy with short black hair and blue swim shorts and Nina, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow swimsuit.
